purpose: Recover the known-good LSJ/Sophocles expansion layer without restoring superseded Wiktionary base mappings.
merge_policy: Only keys present in the reference but absent from its exact base are expansion entries. Restore marked surface forms only, excluding generated accent-stripped fallback keys as well as mappings that conflict with the pinned 1.3.1 resolved lookup or current nonlexical classifications. Add remaining missing keys to the target and preserve every existing target mapping. The carried baseline is the table published from 1.3.7 to 1.3.25. No key it lacked is added, and a key it had returns only under a stated rule: an excluded conflict it carried with the expansion reading; the expansion keys of a superseded noun lemma for which the noun audits record no resolved genitive (no fresh paradigm), when the lemma is a positive lexical head and the key a structurally possible spelling, reduced to the citation spelling where the old paradigm ignored a printed third-declension ending; a regular masculine or neuter cell of an oxytone head in -ός that is a positive lexical head mapped to itself, not a Sophocles-only twin of another head and not a superseded noun; a key of a head the Sophocles breathing review corrected, written with the corrected head where the target has the breathed spelling under it; and an accent-stripped key where the marked target forms that strip to it read the same lemma, comparing lemma spellings with a leading spacing breathing folded and breathing corrections applied, not consulting a grave form whose acute twin is a key, and not counting a reading that is no positive lexical head against a lemma a list other than Sophocles confirms. A fresh reading whose lemma has no diacritic does not replace the published reading under the positive head with the same letters.
